stem: An insurance analytics team needs a managed relational engine for advanced JSON processing, custom extension usage, and complex SQL query plans.

choices.text: Use MySQL on Amazon RDS for extension-heavy JSON workloads by default.
Use Amazon DocumentDB as the primary PostgreSQL extension host.
Use Amazon MemoryDB as the relational JSON query engine.

rationale: RDS guidance identifies PostgreSQL for advanced JSON handling, complex queries, and extensibility needs. MySQL is often preferred for broader compatibility and simpler transactional patterns. DocumentDB and MemoryDB are different data models and do not replace the required relational feature profile.
